verification.summary: The planned Register webapp's registration and identity-claim flow has not been implemented or tested yet. The only recorded evidence is repository/registry integrity verification: the subdomain-registry repository's own integrity suite passed 13/13 (valid JSON records, required fields, domain nesting and proxy rules, single-character limits, per-user ownership) plus the reserved-order check, run from source at commit eb6bc17 — these verify the registry data workflow, not the Register application's core flow.
verification.source: Repository/registry integrity test run (ava integrity suite + reserved-order script) in the AppMintly engineering environment — not an application-flow test
verification.limitations: Repository/registry integrity tests do not prove the Register webapp's core flow works, and a checksum or passing suite never proves security or release readiness. No core-flow, device, or release verification exists; the project stays Planned.

verification.summary: No production build artifact exists to verify: the inspected repository contains registry data and tests, with no build pipeline output for a Register webapp (the webapp itself is still Planned).
